description: This file defines the 'User' class within the OrangeHRM authentication module, managing user session attributes, authentication status, and related user information for the HRM system.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Manages user session attributes and authentication state within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the User class.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Retrieves the current session object.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets a session attribute by name.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a session attribute by name, with optional default.

methods.name: hasAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a session attribute exists.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes a session attribute.

methods.name: getAllAttributes
methods.description: Returns all session attributes.

methods.name: addFlash
methods.description: Adds a flash message of a specified type.

methods.name: getFlash
methods.description: Retrieves flash messages of a specified type.

methods.name: hasFlash
methods.description: Checks if there are flash messages of a specified type.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if the user is authenticated.

methods.name: setIsAuthenticated
methods.description: Sets the user's authentication status.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Gets the user ID from the session.

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Sets the user ID in the session.

methods.name: getUserRoleId
methods.description: Gets the user role ID.

methods.name: setUserRoleId
methods.description: Sets the user role ID.

methods.name: getUserRoleName
methods.description: Retrieves the user's role name.

methods.name: setUserRoleName
methods.description: Sets the user's role name.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number.

methods.name: getUserLastModified
methods.description: Retrieves the last modification timestamp of the user.

methods.name: setUserLastModified
methods.description: Sets the last modification timestamp of the user.

methods.name: getHasAdminAccess
methods.description: Checks if the user has admin access.

methods.name: setHasAdminAccess
methods.description: Sets the admin access attribute for user.
